limitations: Synthetic results are training or previously inspected development diagnostics, not unseen-source accuracy.
Expected disagreement on fractional antialiased labels has a nonzero hard-label floor.
Real errors are against derived masks, not original artwork or cutting ground truth.
Cross-target scores reuse candidates and engine physical checks, not alternate-target editable certification.
The timed fitter can stop at different refinement steps; there were no repeated fits selected for reporting.
No physical cutting, threading or paper-strength tests.

changedAcceptance.finding: All four have a successful candidate meeting image/feature/engine physical checks on both targets. Counts alone cannot assign a causal gain to NN training.

rootCauses.flower: 301 changed pixels; feature list changes from five regions to four; three-cut colour retention becomes passing and moves ahead of closer five-cut fit. Same shortlist, different ranking. Fixed-work ABBA reproduces this exactly. Final 4.445625% versus 9.7725%.
rootCauses.singleHeart: 148 changed pixels; shortlist exchanges five-cut and four-cut grids. Both retain the two-cut grid, but later search returns a failing three-cut candidate for the new mask; available control two-cut geometry passes both targets at 2.56625/2.57%. Rank swap alone does not prove the entire downstream causal chain.
rootCauses.wolf: 132 changed pixels; identical shortlist and first count. Both final fits have low image error, but only new candidate passes paper checks. Later continuous geometry differs.
rootCauses.fourHearts: 345 changed pixels; same shortlist and first count. Available control candidate passes both targets; final own-mask errors straddle 3%.
rootCauses.dragonfly: 184 changed pixels; original control first fine grid stops at 50/150 steps after 0.867 s against an 800 ms deadline. Proposal completes 150. Timing is a material confound, not an established learned gain.
rootCauses.preprocessing: Six unresolved crops plus two visibly inappropriate selections retained. Printed ink/reflections remain; these are separate from routing sensitivity.
